annotations.title: PPE for one of my chemicals

description: Return the personal protective equipment and exposure-control lines printed in Section 8 of the SDS on file for a product in your own SDSentry inventory (eye/face, hand, skin and body, respiratory, engineering controls, hygiene), copied as printed, with a link to the sheet. When Section 8 cannot be read, the answer says to see SDS Section 8; nothing is inferred from the product name. Products you do not hold are not looked up here (use find_safety_data_sheet). Needs a personal SDSentry access token (created by the account owner in SDSentry, Admin, AI assistants) and an account on a free trial or a paid plan. Read-only; reads only that account's data.

product.description: Product name as it appears in your SDSentry inventory, e.g. "Acetone".
